jfk.text: And so, my fellow Americans, ask not what your country can do for you. Ask what you can do for your country.

librispeech-1272-128104-0004.text: Linnell's pictures are a sort of up-guards-and-atom paintings, and Mason's exquisite idylls are as national as a jingo poem. Mr. Burkett Foster's landscapes smile at one much in the same way that Mr. Carker used to flash his teeth. And Mr. John Collier gives his sitter a cheerful slap on the back before he says, like a shampooer in a Turkish bath, Next man!
